newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet on Monday, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers, USDA said.
Inquiry was moderate, demand light. Asking prices $67.00 to $68.00 per cwt, with bids $65.00, last sales of significant quantity were on Tuesday, July 29 at $66.00.
Sales confirmed for the week to date 13,300 cattle, all previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - none last week - 300 last year - none
Wk to date - 13,300 last week - 7,300 last year - 8,800
